basic_info.description: Beautifully updated 1911 Edwardian on a prime block of 11th Ave in the Inner Richmond. Three bedrooms on one level, two and half baths. This three-level home highlights period charm with modern updates. Main level features a formal living room with original moldings, fireplace, and casement windows, a dining room with beamed ceilings and French doors to a spacious deck, and a kitchen with a breakfast area, new appliances and fixtures. A charming powder room with glazed tile and stylish finishes completes the level. Upstairs offers a large primary suite with updated en-suite bath, two additional bedrooms (one with walk-in closet), a skylit hall bath, and refinished hardwood floors throughout. Garage level includes 2-car tandem parking, laundry area, and access to a deep, landscaped backyard with new fencing and plantings. Additional highlights include new light fixtures, restored wood stairs, and multiple skylights. Ideally located near Balboa & Anza, with easy access to Golden Gate Park, Clement Street shops, dining, and transit.
